description: Free. Probes any x402 endpoint WITHOUT paying and reports what it actually charges, to which wallet, on which network, and how that compares with its public Coinbase Bazaar listing (price, recipient, distinct payers in the last 30 days). Returns facts and named signals such as pay_to_differs_from_listing; it does not score or recommend. Works for services that have nothing to do with Tollkit.
